name: Godrej Agrovet Limited
summary: Godrej Agrovet Limited, an agri-business company, provides products and services that enhance crop and livestock yields in India and internationally. The company operates through Animal Feed, Vegetable Oil, Crop Protection, Dairy, Poultry and Processed Food, and Other segments. It offers animal feed, such as cattle, poultry, and aqua feed. The company also engages in the oil palm cultivation with approximately 75,000 hectares of plantations across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Goa, Maharashtra, and Mizoram producing crude palm oil, crude palm kernel oil, and palm kernel cake.
